author: TeIq
content: Delivered: api/cases.rs with 4 handlers (subject view, incident list, submit action, escalate) all ≤ 25 lines orchestrating validation + repo + response. api/error.rs ApiError thiserror enum with IntoResponse impl producing {error, code} JSON for 401/404/400/409/500. api/dto.rs slim CaseView + IncidentSummary + SubmitAction types. api/policy.rs with KNOWN_POLICY_REFS allow-list. api/state.rs ApiState carrying Arc<PgFooRepo> for the 5 aggregates. IncidentRepo gained update_status() narrow mutation method (incidents are stateful; actions stay append-only). Auth middleware mounted via .route_layer on /api/cases/* subtree only — healthz + OIDC routes exempt. 1 new .sqlx cache entry for the update_status macro. moderator_id sourced from Extension<ModeratorAuthCtx>, never request body.
